about: Every benchmark number this repository has measured or relies on. Model output, not readings. AUC: pixel AUC against the segment's 20260918 human labels inside its supervision mask (kit auc). auc_reversed: the same map read with depth reversed, the control. window crop: the segment's 640 px densest-labelled-ink window; inner_px: edge left out; map_from: full = cut from a whole-segment map, bare-crop = inferred on the crop alone (equal to full when inner_px is 64).

held_out.w045: held out from v8in only. ink_9um trained on this surface through its 2.399 um render pooled to 9.6 um (label dataset segment pherc0139-w029); d9v2 and Reader v2 start from ink_9um, and Reader v2 also trained on w045. Our scores use the native 9.362 um render: a cross-scan check on a training surface for those readers. See docs/logs/2026-10-08-w045-not-held-out.md
held_out.PHerc0841: not in the training data of ink_9um (its label dataset has no PHerc0841 segment; docs/logs/2026-10-08-w045-not-held-out.md), v8in or v8in-1447 (v8in's card lists no PHerc0841 segment; v8in-1447 fine-tunes on PHerc1447 w058 and w060 only), d9v2 (TAUIL's README holds out all three PHerc0841 segments, Community report) or Reader v2 (its train_config.json lists no PHerc0841 segment, Community report): the held-out test for those readers. Possibly not held out from Hecate: Hecate's base model scrollprize/ink_canonical_2um (recipe new_canon_autoresearch_recipe, epoch 13, step 113,246) has a committed trainer, ScrollPrize/villa 94602c91 ink-detection/train_resnet3d_3d_decoder.py, that lists w00 and both PHerc0841 auto_grown segments as training fragments (lines 200-207, 292-293) and holds out only l5_0_crop (line 794) (Sourced fact); that the released weights came from that list is Interpretation. Treat Hecate's PHerc0841 scores, and the team's new_canon_autoresearch_recipe maps of PHerc0841, as possibly in-sample. See docs/logs/2026-10-09-pherc0841-hecate.md
